name: USCIS naturalization and green card applications by field office
description: Applications to U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services for naturalization (Form N-400, general and military) and for a green card by adjustment of status (Form I-485, family, employment, humanitarian and other), received, approved, denied and pending at every USCIS field office and service centre, for each fiscal quarter USCIS has published, with the nationwide totals. Read cell for cell from the agency's quarterly performance workbooks and tied to its service-wide quarterly totals. Every cell is kept as published and never estimated.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). USCIS naturalization and green card applications by field office (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964258
keywords: I-485 adjustment of status by field office

distribution.name: uscis-offices.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: uscis-offices.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: uscis-offices-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in uscis-offices-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to uscis-offices.csv on id.

recordSet.name: uscis-offices
recordSet.description: The records of USCIS naturalization and green card applications by field office, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id: dataset, place and period

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter code of the state or territory the office sits in, or US (the nationwide record, and the two centres USCIS lists without a state)

field.name: officeCode
field.description: USCIS's own three-letter office code (US for the nationwide record)

field.name: officeName
field.description: Office name as USCIS prints it (the I-485 file's spelling where the two files differ)

field.name: officeType
field.description: field-office, service-center, national-benefits-center or us

field.name: fiscalYear
field.description: Federal fiscal year (October 1 to September 30) of the quarter

field.name: quarter
field.description: Fiscal quarter 1 to 4 (Q1 is October to December)

field.name: periodStart
field.description: First day of the quarter

field.name: periodEnd
field.description: Last day of the quarter

field.name: status
field.description: P: read from the primary source

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: Same as periodStart

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Same as periodEnd

field.name: text
field.description: One plain sentence with the office's counts

field.name: value
field.description: N-400 and I-485 applications received in the quarter (the totals columns added); counts only

field.name: unit
field.description: What value counts

field.name: i485_fam_rec
field.description: Applications received in the quarter, Form I-485, family-based

field.name: i485_fam_app
field.description: Applications approved in the quarter, Form I-485, family-based

field.name: i485_fam_den
field.description: Applications denied in the quarter, Form I-485, family-based

field.name: i485_fam_pen
field.description: Applications pending at the end of the quarter, Form I-485, family-based

field.name: i485_emp_rec
field.description: Applications received in the quarter, Form I-485, employment-based (received at service centres)

field.name: i485_emp_app
field.description: Applications approved in the quarter, Form I-485, employment-based (received at service centres)

field.name: i485_emp_den
field.description: Applications denied in the quarter, Form I-485, employment-based (received at service centres)

field.name: i485_emp_pen
field.description: Applications pending at the end of the quarter, Form I-485, employment-based (received at service centres)

field.name: i485_hum_rec
field.description: Applications received in the quarter, Form I-485, humanitarian-based (asylee, refugee, Indochinese, Cuban)

field.name: i485_hum_app
field.description: Applications approved in the quarter, Form I-485, humanitarian-based (asylee, refugee, Indochinese, Cuban)

field.name: i485_hum_den
field.description: Applications denied in the quarter, Form I-485, humanitarian-based (asylee, refugee, Indochinese, Cuban)

field.name: i485_hum_pen
field.description: Applications pending at the end of the quarter, Form I-485, humanitarian-based (asylee, refugee, Indochinese, Cuban)

field.name: i485_oth_rec
field.description: Applications received in the quarter, Form I-485, other categories (for example crime and trafficking victims)

field.name: i485_oth_app
field.description: Applications approved in the quarter, Form I-485, other categories (for example crime and trafficking victims)

field.name: i485_oth_den
field.description: Applications denied in the quarter, Form I-485, other categories (for example crime and trafficking victims)

field.name: i485_oth_pen
field.description: Applications pending at the end of the quarter, Form I-485, other categories (for example crime and trafficking victims)

field.name: i485_tot_rec
field.description: Applications received in the quarter, Form I-485, all categories

field.name: i485_tot_app
field.description: Applications approved in the quarter, Form I-485, all categories

field.name: i485_tot_den
field.description: Applications denied in the quarter, Form I-485, all categories

field.name: i485_tot_pen
field.description: Applications pending at the end of the quarter, Form I-485, all categories

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: Date the source file was last read

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
